name: Kid Chameleon Native Build: Level 1 Graphics Iteration
description: Build the next iteration of the native Kid Chameleon port with a primary focus on getting Level 1 rendered natively using ROM-extracted assets and modern native rendering infrastructure. The target outcome is a playable build where the full Level 1 is traversable and visually recognisable as the original opening level, while keeping architecture clean enough to support later gameplay and presentation work.

userStories.title: Asset and rendering foundation
userStories.description: - ROM extraction flow for required Level 1 graphics - Asset manifests/metadata shape finalised - Native renderer can draw static level visuals

userStories.title: Playable visual slice
userStories.description: - Player rendered in-world - Camera and traversal integrated - Opening section feels recognisable as Kid Chameleon

userStories.title: Full Level 1 traversal
userStories.description: - Entire level traversable start to exit - Rough edges acceptable where explicitly deferred - Oracle scenarios added for key checkpoints

userStories.title: Stretch pass
userStories.description: - Improve gameplay fidelity for core platforms/collisions/pickups/hazards - Add enemies, pickups, HUD rendering if scope allows
